usage: The word '凍雪碧' is used as a noun to refer specifically to the drink 'Iced Sprite'.
You can order '凍雪碧' at restaurants or cafes when you want a cold Sprite.
In conversations, '凍雪碧' can be paired with verbs like '飲' (to drink) or '要' (to want) to form common phrases.
'凍雪碧' can be part of sentences indicating preference, e.g., '我想飲凍雪碧' means 'I want to drink iced Sprite.'
